source_example.description: Use the full path of source files, creating any missing intermediate directories when copying:

descdev-v1-common-preserve-source-folder.rationale: pages/common/cp.md example 8 documents cp --parents: retain the source path and create missing intermediate directories. Other copy examples do not preserve the full source folder path.

descdev-v1-common-literal-punctuation-se.rationale: pages/common/grep.md example 2 disables regex interpretation with fixed-strings and matches literal punctuation in a file. Other grep examples use regex patterns or add behavior not requested.

descdev-v1-common-quoted-csv-sort.rationale: Pinned common pages are cat, cp, find, grep, sed, and sort. sort.md examples 5-6 split fields at a single separator and do not parse quoted CSV cells. No selected example implements CSV-aware column sorting.

source_example.description: Show logs for a given unit since the last time it started:

descdev-v1-linux-current-service-run-log.rationale: pages/linux/journalctl.md example 4 filters by the current systemd InvocationID, selecting messages since the unit last started. Unit-only and boot/time filters do not isolate the current invocation.

source_example.description: List interfaces with brief link layer info:

descdev-v1-linux-compact-link-details.rationale: pages/linux/ip.md example 3 lists brief link-layer information, including interface names, hardware addresses, and link state. Its brief address example shows network-layer addresses instead.

descdev-v1-linux-per-process-memory-rank.rationale: Pinned Linux pages are apt, df, free, ip, journalctl, and systemctl, plus eligible common pages. free.md reports system-wide memory totals; no selected example enumerates or ranks process RAM consumption.

descdev-v1-osx-reveal-file-in-finder.rationale: pages/osx/open.md example 5 uses open -R to reveal the given file in Finder. Opening a file normally launches its associated application; opening the current directory does not select the given file.

descdev-v1-osx-screenshot-to-clipboard.rationale: pages/osx/screencapture.md examples save captures to files or open Preview; none captures directly to the clipboard. pbcopy.md copies stdin/file data and has no screenshot image capture example. No selected example meets direct image capture without a saved file.

descdev-v1-osx-audio-transcription.rationale: pages/osx/say.md converts supplied text to speech, including speech audio-file creation. No selected common or macOS example recognizes speech from existing audio or produces a transcript.

source_example.description: Find a literal string (containing spaces) in all text files:

descdev-v1-windows-literal-multiword-tex.rationale: pages/windows/findstr.md example 6 uses /c to match a literal string containing spaces in *.txt. Other findstr examples treat space-separated words as alternatives or use regex; common grep is excluded by the requested built-in Command Prompt command.

descdev-v1-windows-recursive-copy-with-e.rationale: pages/windows/copy.md examples copy files or wildcard matches, with no recursive tree-copy operation or preservation of empty directories. Common cp.md examples 3-4 describe recursive copying but are not built-in Windows Command Prompt commands. No selected example meets the requested built-in cmd operation.

descdev-v1-windows-recent-directory-filt.rationale: pages/windows/get-childitem.md example 2 lists directories but has no modification-time cutoff; dir.md example 6 sorts by date without filtering. Common find.md example 7 selects items modified today and executes a command, but is not a PowerShell cmdlet. No selected example filters directories by a seven-day cutoff using a cmdlet.
